study_scope: Prospective12-reaction ModelSEED boundary calculation, with primary-source identities and three molecule-local state policies; no independent experimental-accuracy claim.
selection: All12anchor-retaining admitted requests from the frozen four-cofactor input audit. All18participating source-cross-referenced nucleotide/cofactor identities fixed from owned ChEBI structures before energies. No numerical reaction labels are read.
core_approximation: Ghat(full reduced isomer)=G(full exact oxidized sibling)+G(methyl reduced isomer)-G(methyl oxidized core). Separate exact NAD/NADP scaffolds; isomer-specific cores. Unmatched molecules use full states; undeclared reduced nicotinamide isomers refuse.
hypothesis: A common molecular reference can make local1,2/1,4isomer energetics identifiable without mixing a full isomer energy with an unrelated approximate reference. This is not assumed to improve experimental accuracy.
raw_engine: UMA-s1p2p1/Nitro FP32, gas-phase conformer search and per-minimum UMA Hessian RRHO plus GFN2-xTB/ALPB; inherited standard-state and class/source protonation terms. No solver/grid/solvent substitution.
numerical_profile: Same accepted-minimum Hamiltonian/components as retained bank; current bounded curvature-recovery source and a predeclared96-candidate validation ceiling for new molecules. Original64-ceiling records retain their provenance and are reused only when already fully validated; no reference-thermal approximation.
analysis: Availability/refusal of all12requests under each frozen arm; no missing value becomeszero
Unrounded reaction energies and component sensitivities; no MAE or direction claim without independent references
All reversal, extent2, atom-order, species-order checks and repeated-state equality
Complete available stoichiometric nullspace, including explicit protons
1,4-to1,2full-minus-core isomer transfer and model dependence of all scaffold-boundary predictions
Shared primitive uncertainty derivatives, including exact cancellation of common full-reference and oxidized-core terms
Per-molecule actual resource cost, failures and raw-source identity; cache reuse separated from fresh work
nonadoption_rule: All arms retained. No selection of a production policy by closure or favorable energies; unknown scaffold interactions, sampling convergence, charged-state solvation and protonation accuracy remain limitations.
worker_failure_definition: Three consecutive runtime exceptions/timeouts stop that worker. A completed scientific quality refusal is recorded with one attempt and does not trigger an environment circuit breaker. No refusal is retried.
